json.B: OSEQ - Transaction is being reported late and is out of sequence
json.C: CNCL - Transaction is the last reported for the particular option contract and is now cancelled
json.D: LATE - Transaction is being reported late, but is in the correct sequence
json.E: CNCO - Transaction was the first one (opening) reported this day for the particular option contract and is now cancelled
json.F: OPEN - Transaction is a late report of the opening trade and is out of sequence
json.G: CNOL - Transaction was the only one reported this day for the particular option contract and is now to be cancelled
json.H: OPNL - Transaction is a late report of the opening trade, but is in the correct sequence
json.J: REOP - Transaction is a reopening of an option contract in which trading has been previously halted
json.S: ISOI - Transaction was the execution of an order identified as an Intermarket Sweep Order

json.m: MFSL - Multi Leg floor trade against single leg(s)
json.q: TESL - Stock Options autoelectronic trade against single leg(s)
json.r: TASL - Stock Options Auction against single leg(s)
json.s: TFSL - Stock Options floor trade against single leg(s)
json.t: CBMO - Multi Leg Floor Trade of Proprietary Products
json.u: MCTP - Multilateral Compression Trade of Proprietary Products
